tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The KNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons.
Office will provide the monthly attendance details of deployed manpower to prepare a bill by contractor
Pay-slip shall be provided to deployed manpower and pay statement shall be submitted to the Office every month
If the percentage quoted by contractor for the Manpower works is below the DSR rates / Minimum wages including EPF & ESI such tenderer will be rejected.
The invoices of GST bill paid, ESI, EPF previously paid should be enclosed with pay bill.
The persons employed through the agency are not permanent Government employees, hence their service may be dismissed any time.

The agency for any reason should not give less salary than that stipulated by the WRD/ Labor Dept./ PWD Dept. for Man Power Works, if agency quoted below the minimum wages, then the tender will not be accepted

The percentage quoted for the service charge for tendering services shall be equal to or can be above minimum wages. Service charges shall not be negative and zero limiting to first decimal. Negative tenders will be strictly rejected.
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.

If there are more than one number of L1 bidders then the bidder selection will be done by lottery process at division office level and the decision of the tender inviting authority is final in this regard.
